sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩和主角媽媽在市場魚攤前，看著幾條魚，魚販正在賣魚，媽媽覺得魚賣得不貴。魚販是一般市場攤販，不能長得像主角媽媽或老師。畫面要呈現「魚正在被賣，而且不貴」的情境，但不可有價目表、文字、數字、招牌、品牌或標籤。

sentences.text: 小馬賣力跑，還是不夠快。

sentences.imagePrompt: square image / 1:1 composition. Use the approved L058 lesson images only as style references: warm picture-book pencil-and-watercolor linework, soft natural light, detailed but clean environments, expressive preschool proportions for animal characters, gentle expressions, bright warm palette, phone-readable square composition. Do not copy any specific person, clothing, hair, face, or body shape from L058. A small young horse runs very hard on a safe grassy path or simple practice track with no lane numbers. The horse leans forward with determined expression, moving legs, and effort, but another horse farther ahead or a clear remaining distance suggests it is still not fast enough. Center the running little horse and the distance cue with safe margins. No humans are required. No readable text, numbers, track numbers, signs, labels, brands, logos, watermarks, or written marks.
sentences.imageNotes: 一匹小馬在草地或安全跑道上很努力地跑，姿勢用力、表情認真，但旁邊可有另一匹馬或跑道前方距離暗示牠還是不夠快。畫面重點是「小馬很賣力跑，但速度還不夠快」。不可有文字、數字、跑道號碼、標籤或招牌。
